resources.string: Please follow these guidelines to help make sure your cleaning appointment goes smoothly and that the cleaner has enough space to do their job properly.

• Please make sure that the cleaner has access to your room at the scheduled cleaning time.

• Try to tidy up your room before the cleaner arrives so that the cleaning areas are easy to reach.

• Keep personal belongings such as clothes, shoes, bags and other items away from areas that need to be cleaned, no lost item will be held accountable.

• Remove any valuable or important belongings from areas where cleaning will take place.

• Make sure there are no dangerous objects, sharp items or other hazards that could cause an injury.

• If there is a specific area you would like the cleaner to focus on, mention it in the special instructions when making your booking.

• Please make sure your selected room number is correct when submitting your cleaning request.

• Try to be available around the scheduled time in case the cleaner needs to contact you.

• Please give the cleaner enough space to move around and complete the cleaning safely.

• If you have any specific cleaning requests, communicate them clearly and politely to the cleaner.

• Avoid leaving personal belongings in areas that the cleaner needs to access.

• Please do not interfere with cleaning equipment while the cleaner is working.

• If the cleaner needs clarification about your request, provide the necessary information so the cleaning can be completed correctly.

• Once the cleaning is complete, check that the areas included in your request have been cleaned properly.

• If you are satisfied with the cleaning, you can leave the room ready for normal use.

• If you notice a problem with the cleaning, report it through the Report a Problem section.

• When reporting a problem, provide a clear description of the issue and upload a photo where possible to help explain the problem.

• For questions about your booking or cleaning service, contact residence management for assistance.

Please remember to treat cleaning staff respectfully and provide accurate information when submitting a cleaning request. Following these guidelines helps the cleaning process run smoothly and ensures that both students and cleaning staff have a positive experience.
